technical.summary: EPAM shows mixed technicals with oversold oscillators and some bullish structure (Ichimoku, SuperTrend, EMA 20/50) but lacks momentum confirmation; price below key EMAs, negative MACD, and weak volume signals suggest caution despite potential reversal setup.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 58 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with Republican senior member purchases offset by Democratic sale
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (106-120 days old), with no recent news sentiment to confirm conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (308.0) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational IT revenues, and earnings in 58 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI (31.96-32.43), SuperTrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, and extreme market fear (26/100) create contrarian reversal setup with price near support (405.05) offering defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 308, strong dollar), negative MACD momentum, price below all key EMAs, weak volume, no institutional conviction, and earnings event risk in 58 days outweigh technical oversold conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: While oversold RSI and contrarian fear present a technical setup, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) combined with negative momentum (MACD, price below EMAs, weak volume) and upcoming earnings event risk within 58 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs the reversal opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 58 days amid recession-signal macro environment (inverted yield curve) could trigger sharp downside gap; current VIX crisis (308) suggests market stress will likely persist through earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance; technical agents acknowledge oversold conditions but confirm momentum weakness and volume failure; fundamental and risk agents strongly negative; sentiment contrarian signal insufficient to override macro severity.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 14 positions in Information Technology sector; adding EPAM increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without conviction catalyst.
